violations.why: Force ISR (prio 3) preempts Timer_A between read and write of timerCount++, losing its update.
Force ISR can preempt between the read and write of timerCount++ and write 0.
Force ISR can overwrite timerCount between the increment and the check in Timer_A.
Force ISR sets timerCount to 0 between the increment and the check, so the check sees a different value.
Force ISR sets timerCount to 0 between Timer_B's write of 1 and its check, so the check sees 0.
Force ISR changes timerCount between Timer_A's two reads.
